lore: Ask the brigade about MiseOS DevOps Project Harvester and they describe the loading dock before dawn. As Operations Kitchen's specialist for tooling, MiseOS DevOps Project Harvester scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on, and the rest of the kitchen plans service around that rhythm.
